summary: The generator ran exactly once and produced contract-order fields, but the targeted test required a conflicting order; the generated artifact was not hand-edited.

claims.claim: The generator produced FIELDS in accepted OpenAPI property order: displayName, id, name.
The targeted test contradicts the generated order and failed deterministically.
Only generated/user_fields.py was added to this worker's write set and user-notes.md remained unchanged.
evidence: Scoped Git diff: one generated file, 4 insertions and 4 deletions

uncertainty: T4 was not authorized to decide whether the test or schema property order should change.

artifacts_or_changes.state: generator-produced but blocked by upstream contradiction

contradictions: Accepted schema order displayName,id,name and deterministic generator behavior conflict with test-required id,name,displayName.

root_disposition.resolution: Revise the upstream schema contract to preserve id,name and append displayName; then invalidate downstream receipts and rerun review/codegen.
